description: Figure 4 is a line plot with the x-axis labeled "Layer" and the y-axis labeled "Abs Mean". The x-axis ranges from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis ranges from 0 to 4, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71", a green solid line representing the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05", and a red dotted line representing the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". The blue dashed line starts at approximately 0.71 and remains relatively flat until around layer 10, where it begins to rise sharply, reaching a peak of around 4 at layer 20. The green solid line starts at 0.05 and remains flat throughout the plot. The red dotted line starts at 0.04 and remains flat throughout the plot.
